issues.description: Farm.singFarmSong() has inconsistent return types across artifacts. The problem statement describes singFarmSong() as printing the song (void), and the template declares `public void singFarmSong()`, but the solution declares `public String singFarmSong()` and returns the concatenated song text instead of printing it. This creates ambiguity for students and can break expected usage/tests tied to the void/printing contract.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the contract across problem statement, template, and solution: either keep `singFarmSong()` as `void` and print the verses in the solution, or change the problem statement and template to specify `String singFarmSong()` returning the full song text (and adapt any example usage accordingly).

issues.description: Farm.singFarmSongVerse(...) is inconsistent: the UML/problem statement specifies a private helper `singFarmSongVerse(animal: Animal): void` (printing a verse), and the template provides a void method that prints, but the solution implements `private String singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` returning verse text. This mismatch amplifies the print-vs-return confusion and changes the intended decomposition of the task.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose one approach and apply it everywhere: (A) keep `singFarmSongVerse(Animal)` as `void` and print directly (update solution), or (B) update UML/problem statement/template to specify `String singFarmSongVerse(Animal)` and have `singFarmSong()` concatenate/print the returned verses.

issues.description: The template Farm.singFarmSongVerse is declared without a usable parameter (`private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)`), while the UML/problem statement and the solution require an `Animal animal` parameter. Students following the specification cannot match the template signature, and uncommenting call sites would not compile against the provided stub.
issues.suggestedFix: Fix the template signature to include the parameter: `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` (or `private String singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` if adopting the solution’s return-String design) and ensure imports/types are present.
